Programs

A program runs your plan for a set number of weeks, through phases that build and then deload. Optional — your plan already works without one, and nothing you have logged is affected.

My Gym

Tell LOOP what you can actually train with. Anything you leave alone stays unknown rather than assumed unavailable — nothing is removed from your plans or history either way.

Backup & Data

Your training data lives on this device. Export it to keep a copy you control.
Importing merges by workout, so re-importing the same file changes nothing and an older backup can never delete newer sessions.
This permanently erases every workout, record, and level. It cannot be undone. Export a backup first.
